Congress's demand for 180–200 seats has emerged as a key sticking point in its alliance talks with Akhilesh Yadav's Samajwadi Party ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. With both sides negotiating their share, can the INDIA bloc avoid repeating the mistakes of its failed 2017 alliance? Neeta Sharma and Indian Express reporters decode the seat-sharing battle in this episode of Express Newsroom.
The Indian Express brings you comprehensive coverage of global & indian politics, election news, business news, world affairs, sports, entertainment, Bollywood, and public policy.
